meaning: adj. 熟練的；有專業技能的

meaning: adj. 餓極了的；非常飢餓的

The new laboratory is equipped with state-of-the-art technology. (新實驗室配備了最先進的技術。)

meaning: adj. 意志堅定的；堅強果斷的

The marketing team is discussing new tactics to increase engagement. (行銷團隊正在討論提升參與度的新策略。)

meaning: adj. 量身打造的；依需求調整的

meaning: adj. 客製化的；量身訂做的

meaning: adj. 有才華的；有天分的

meaning: adj. 顯示重要資訊的；有說服力的

meaning: adj. 有主題的；以特定主題設計的

meaning: adj. 令人振奮的；令人激動的

meaning: adj. 蓬勃發展的；興旺的

meaning: adj. 頂級的；最高規格的

We need to address the underlying cause of the problem. (我們需要處理這個問題的根本原因。)

meaning: adj. 人手不足的；人力短缺的

meaning: adj. 堅定不移的；毫不動搖的

meaning: adj. 起伏不定的；時好時壞的

meaning: adj. 最新的；保持更新的

meaning: n. 貴重物品；值錢物品

meaning: n. 暖身活動；開場活動

meaning: adj. 抗水的；具防潑水功能的

meaning: adj. 均衡的；平衡良好的

meaning: adj. 受過良好教育的；學識豐富的

He is willing to help if you ask him. (如果你開口請他幫忙，他會很樂意協助。)

meaning: n. 逛街看櫥窗；只逛不買

meaning: phr. A 與 B 都一樣；A 和 B 同樣

meaning: phr. A 以及 B；不僅 B 也包括 A

meaning: phr. A 之後接著是 B；A 結束後舉行 B

meaning: phr. 一整系列的；完整一套的

meaning: phr. 一份……的副本；……的影本

meaning: phr. 出席人數眾多；出席踴躍

meaning: phr. 一封感謝信；感謝函

The artisanal bakery sources premium wheat to bake a perfect loaf of sourdough. (這家手作麵包店採用優質小麥，烘焙出完美的酸種麵包。)

meaning: phr. 一件設備；一項器材

meaning: phr. 一系列；各種各樣的

meaning: phr. 精選的；挑選出的一批

meaning: phr. 一連串；接連發生的

meaning: phr. 各式各樣的；多種不同的

meaning: phr. 接受邀約；接受聘用條件

meaning: phr. 聯外道路；通行道路

meaning: phr. 使用……的權限；取得……的途徑

meaning: phr. 應付帳款；尚未支付的款項

meaning: phr. 達成某人的目標；實現目標

meaning: phr. 在街道對面；在馬路另一側

meaning: phr. 總計達到；累積造成

meaning: phr. 額外收費；附加費用

meaning: phr. 向聽眾發表談話；對觀眾演說

meaning: phr. 調整後照鏡；調整鏡子位置

meaning: phr. 進入……的資格；獲准進入

meaning: phr. 事先預約；預先訂位

meaning: phr. 廣告活動；宣傳企畫

meaning: phr. 通知 A 有關 B 的事；告知 A B

meaning: phr. 排除萬難；儘管困難重重

meaning: phr. 提前；早於預定進度

meaning: phr. 各行各業；各種社會背景

meaning: phr. 校友會；畢業生聯誼會

meaning: phr. 週年慶祝活動；週年紀念典禮

meaning: phr. 年度預算；年度經費規劃

The receptionist is trained to answer the phone professionally and route calls to the appropriate department. (總機人員受過訓練，能專業地接聽電話並將來電轉接至適當部門。)

meaning: phr. 即將到來的；近在眼前的

meaning: phr. 世界各地；遍及全球

meaning: phr. 安排會議；籌辦研討會

meaning: phr. 安排預約；約定會面時間

meaning: phr. 將商品陳列在貨架上；排列貨架商品

meaning: phr. 擺放家具；安排桌椅配置

meaning: phr. 美術館；藝術博物館

meaning: phr. 出於禮貌；作為善意表示

meaning: phr. 照目前情況；本來就
example: The proposed budget is tight as it is; any further reductions will severely compromise project quality. (提議的預算本來就很吃緊；再刪減會嚴重影響專案品質。)
The client is willing to extend the deadline, as long as the core deliverables are not compromised. (只要核心交付成果的品質不受影響，客戶願意延長期限。)

meaning: phr. 截至目前；目前為止
example: As of now, the human resources department has not received any formal grievances regarding the new policy. (截至目前為止，人資部尚未收到任何關於新政策的正式申訴。)
We decided to invest heavily in sustainable infrastructure, as opposed to pursuing short-term profit margins. (我們決定大力投資永續基礎建設，而非追求短期利潤率。)

meaning: phr. 依照要求；按照所請
example: As requested by the auditing firm, we have compiled all transactional records from the past three fiscal years. (依照會計師事務所的要求，我們已彙整過去三個會計年度的所有交易紀錄。)
Please expedite the approval process and sign the non-disclosure agreement as soon as possible. (請加快簽核流程，並盡快簽署保密協定。)
The comprehensive training module covers advanced troubleshooting as well as basic system maintenance. (這套完整訓練教材涵蓋基礎系統維護以及進階問題排除。)
Aside from a minor logistical hiccup on day one, the international trade expo was a resounding success. (除了第一天發生一點小小的物流問題，這場國際貿易展非常成功。)
The ambitious intern openly stated that she aspires to become a managing partner at the firm one day. (這位企圖心十足的實習生坦言，她渴望有朝一日成為該公司的管理合夥人。)

meaning: phr. 以折扣價；以優惠價格
example: Employees are entitled to purchase company merchandise at a discounted price during the holiday season. (連假期間，員工可用折扣價購買公司商品。)

meaning: phr. 快速地；以高速步調
example: The technology sector is evolving at a fast pace, rendering obsolete skills virtually useless overnight. (科技產業快速演進，讓過時技能幾乎一夕之間失去用處。)

meaning: phr. 以快速的速度；迅速地
example: The startup is burning through its venture capital funding at a rapid rate without showing clear profitability. (這家新創公司正快速耗用創投資金，卻遲遲未展現明確獲利。)

meaning: phr. 連續不間斷地；一口氣地
example: To meet the uncompromising deadline, the development team worked for fourteen hours at a stretch. (為了趕上嚴格的期限，開發團隊連續工作了十四個小時。)

meaning: phr. 以大幅折扣；以優惠甚多的價格
example: The wholesaler offered to liquidate the excess inventory to us at a substantial discount. (批發商提議以大幅折扣將過剩庫存出售給我們。)
The highly secure server is designed to process over a million encrypted transactions at a time. (這台高安全性的伺服器設計上可一次處理超過一百萬筆加密交易。)

meaning: phr. 不惜任何代價；無論如何
example: The management team is absolutely determined to avert a hostile takeover bid at all costs. (經營團隊下定決心，不惜任何代價也要避免遭到惡意併購。)
Employees are mandated to wear their corporate identification badges visibly at all times while on the premises. (員工在公司場所內必須隨時將識別證佩戴在明顯處。)
The manufacturing facility is operating at full speed to fulfill the unprecedented surge in overseas orders. (這座製造廠正全速運轉，以應付前所未有的海外訂單激增。)

meaning: phr. 整體而言；普遍來說
example: The board's sudden decision to oust the CEO took the business community at large by surprise. (董事會突然罷免執行長的決定，讓整個商界都感到意外。)
As a premium subscriber, you are entitled to expedited shipping at no charge on all domestic orders. (身為高級會員，您所有國內訂單都可享有免費快速配送。)

meaning: phr. 不另收費；免費附贈
example: The boutique hotel offers a daily complimentary breakfast buffet at no extra charge for all registered guests. (這間精品飯店為所有住客每日提供免費自助早餐，不另收費。)
The sophisticated software allows the system administrator to monitor dozens of network nodes at once. (這套精密軟體讓系統管理員能同時監控數十個網路節點。)

meaning: phr. 可供某人使用；由某人支配
example: The expatriate executive has a dedicated corporate vehicle and a chauffeur at his disposal. (這位外派主管有專屬公務車和司機可供使用。)

meaning: phr. 應某人要求；依照某人請求
example: The detailed financial audit was initiated immediately at the request of the major shareholders. (應主要股東要求，詳細財務稽核隨即展開。)

meaning: phr. 由……自行決定；由……酌情裁定
example: The allocation of year-end performance bonuses remains solely at the discretion of the management team. (年終績效獎金的分配完全由經營團隊自行裁定。)
The finalized architectural blueprints will be ready for your review by next Wednesday at the earliest. (定稿的建築藍圖最快也要到下週三才能供您審閱。)
The keynote speaker had to cancel his appearance at the last minute due to an unforeseen medical emergency. (專題講者因突發醫療緊急狀況，不得不在最後一刻取消出席。)
Please ensure that the revised quarterly report is submitted to the director by 5 PM Friday at the latest. (請確保修訂後的季度報告最晚在週五下午五點前提交主管。)
At the moment, our HR department is not actively recruiting for any mid-level managerial positions. (目前，人資部沒有積極招募任何中階主管職位。)
The company strives to increase its market share and, at the same time, reduce its carbon footprint. (公司致力於提高市占率，同時減少碳足跡。)
At this point, negotiating a higher severance package seems highly improbable given the company's financial state. (考量公司的財務狀況，目前要談到更高的資遣方案似乎不太可能。)

meaning: phr. 運動技能；體能技巧
example: The talent scout travels internationally to evaluate the athletic skill of promising young basketball players. (球探前往各國，評估有潛力的年輕籃球員的運動技能。)

meaning: phr. 出席會議；參加研討會
example: Several senior engineers will attend a conference in Silicon Valley to discuss emerging AI technologies. (幾位資深工程師將前往矽谷參加會議，討論新興 AI 技術。)

meaning: phr. 接待客戶；處理客戶需求
example: The account manager had to abruptly leave the internal meeting to attend to a VIP client's urgent request. (客戶經理不得不中斷內部會議，趕去處理 VIP 客戶的緊急需求。)

meaning: phr. 自動付款；自動扣款
example: Setting up an automatic payment for your utility bills ensures you never incur late penalty fees. (設定水電費自動扣款，可避免產生逾期罰款。)

meaning: phr. 汽車修理廠；汽車保養廠
example: The logistics company contracts a local automotive repair shop to maintain its fleet of delivery trucks. (這家物流公司與當地汽車修理廠簽約，負責維護其送貨車隊。)

meaning: phr. 頒獎典禮；授獎儀式
example: The annual industry award ceremony will be broadcast live from the metropolitan convention center. (年度產業頒獎典禮將從都會會議中心現場直播。)

meaning: phr. 退出；放棄（計畫或立場）
example: Following the intense public backlash, the conglomerate decided to back away from the controversial merger. (在遭遇強烈公眾反彈後，該集團決定退出這項備受爭議的合併案。)
The warehouse worker filed for workers' compensation after sustaining a severe back injury on the job. (這名倉儲人員在工作中背部嚴重受傷後，申請了職災補償。)

meaning: phr. 缺貨待補；延後出貨的訂單
example: Due to unprecedented demand, the latest gaming console is currently on back order until early November. (由於需求空前旺盛，最新款遊戲主機目前缺貨，預計十一月初才能出貨。)

meaning: phr. 備份；製作備用副本
example: It is mandatory protocol to back up all crucial corporate data to a secure cloud server daily. (每天將所有重要公司資料備份至安全的雲端伺服器，是一項強制規定。)

meaning: phr. 銀行帳戶；銀行存款帳戶
example: Please verify that the routing number is correct before transferring the funds to the offshore bank account. (將資金匯入離岸銀行帳戶前，請先確認銀行代碼正確。)

meaning: phr. 銀行貸款；銀行借款
example: The aggressive expansion plan was entirely financed through a high-interest commercial bank loan. (這項積極的擴張計畫完全仰賴高利率商業銀行貸款籌資。)

meaning: phr. 銀行櫃員；銀行行員
example: The experienced bank teller quickly identified the forged signature on the fraudulent check. (這位經驗豐富的銀行櫃員迅速辨識出偽造支票上的簽名。)

meaning: phr. 就價格議價；協商價格
example: Procurement officers are trained to aggressively bargain over prices with external material suppliers. (採購人員受過訓練，能積極與外部原料供應商議價。)
Employees who need to be absent from work for medical reasons must provide a doctor's note. (因健康因素需要請假的員工必須提供醫師證明。)

meaning: phr. 獲准加入；獲錄取進入
example: Only a fraction of the applicants will be admitted to the prestigious corporate leadership training program. (只有少數申請者會獲准參加這項知名企業領導人才培訓計畫。)

meaning: phr. 被建議做……；最好採取……
example: Passengers are strongly advised to arrive at the departure terminal at least three hours before the international flight. (強烈建議旅客至少在國際航班起飛前三小時抵達出境航廈。)

meaning: phr. 隸屬於；與……有合作關係
example: The non-profit research institute is proudly affiliated with several top-tier Ivy League universities. (這家非營利研究機構以與數所頂尖常春藤名校合作為榮。)
Freelance contractors are not allowed to access the company's internal proprietary source code. (自由接案人員不得存取公司的內部專有原始碼。)

meaning: phr. 對……感到驚訝；對……感到震撼
example: The venture capitalists were thoroughly amazed at the startup's rapid burn rate and lack of profitability. (創投業者對這家新創公司驚人的資金消耗速度及缺乏獲利感到震驚。)
The newly appointed regional manager is extremely anxious to implement his sweeping organizational reforms. (新上任的區域經理非常急於推行全面的組織改革。)

meaning: phr. 被擺設在露台上；安排於露台
example: The cocktail tables and heat lamps will be arranged on the patio for the evening networking reception. (雞尾酒桌和暖爐將擺放在露台上，供晚間交流酒會使用。)
All attendees will be asked to sign a comprehensive non-disclosure agreement before entering the briefing room. (所有與會者進入簡報室前，都會被要求簽署完整的保密協定。)

meaning: phr. 被指派至；被分配到
example: The junior developer was thrilled to be assigned to the highly anticipated flagship software project. (這位初階開發工程師很高興能被指派參與備受矚目的旗艦軟體專案。)
Management must be acutely aware of the potential cyber risks associated with remote working environments. (管理層必須清楚意識到遠距工作環境可能帶來的資安風險。)
The revised financial projections will be entirely based on the actual revenue figures from the previous quarter. (修訂後的財務預測將完全以上一季的實際營收數據為根據。)

meaning: phr. 已被預約滿；行程排滿
example: I'm afraid the prime conference room is fully booked up for the entirety of next week. (恐怕那間主要會議室下週整週都已經預約額滿。)
Routine maintenance on the server infrastructure will be carried out during off-peak hours this weekend. (伺服器基礎架構的例行維護將於本週末離峰時段進行。)

meaning: phr. 受困於；遇上（交通阻塞等）
example: The courier was unfortunately caught in a massive gridlock on the freeway, delaying the urgent delivery. (快遞員不巧受困於高速公路的大塞車，導致緊急貨件延誤。)

meaning: phr. 當天休業；當日停止營業
example: The main branch will be closed for the day on Friday to accommodate a mandatory staff training session. (總行週五將休業一天，以配合強制性的員工訓練。)

meaning: phr. 不對外開放；禁止公眾進入
example: The archaeological site will be closed to the public temporarily while researchers excavate the newly discovered artifacts. (研究人員挖掘新發現的文物期間，這處考古遺址將暫時不對外開放。)

meaning: phr. 封閉交通；禁止車輛通行
example: The main avenue downtown will be closed to traffic this Sunday for the annual city marathon. (市中心主要幹道本週日將封閉交通，以舉辦年度城市馬拉松。)
The independent audit committee must be composed of individuals with extensive backgrounds in corporate finance. (獨立稽核委員會必須由具備豐富企業財務經驗的人士組成。)
The final approval of the merger is strictly contingent upon favorable regulatory clearance from the government. (這項合併案最終能否獲准，完全取決於政府主管機關是否給予核准。)
The new robust encryption protocol is specifically designed to safeguard sensitive client financial data. (這套全新且強大的加密協定專為保護敏感的客戶財務資料而設計。)
The embattled CEO is absolutely determined to turn the struggling company around before the next fiscal year. (這位處境艱難的執行長下定決心，要在下個會計年度前扭轉公司的困境。)
Candidates for this technical role must be thoroughly familiar with cloud computing architecture. (應徵這個技術職位的人必須非常熟悉雲端運算架構。)
The lengthy quarterly report is unfortunately filled with convoluted industry jargon and redundant data. (這份冗長的季度報告充斥著難懂的業界術語和重複資料。)
The executive's keynote speech was full of inspiring anecdotes but severely lacked actionable strategic advice. (這位主管的專題演講充滿激勵人心的故事，卻嚴重缺乏可執行的策略建議。)

meaning: phr. 針對；以……為目標設計
example: The latest intensive marketing campaign is specifically geared toward engaging Gen Z consumers on social media. (最新的密集行銷活動專為在社群媒體上吸引 Z 世代消費者而規劃。)
The extraordinary general meeting will be held virtually to accommodate international stakeholders. (為配合國際利害關係人，股東臨時會將以線上方式舉行。)
The critical shipment of raw materials was held up at customs for three weeks due to incomplete paperwork. (這批重要原料因文件不齊，在海關延誤了三週。)

meaning: phr. 受困於交通壅塞；因塞車延誤
example: The lead negotiator apologized profusely after being held up in traffic for over an hour. (首席談判代表因塞車受困一個多小時，抵達後頻頻致歉。)

meaning: phr. 備受尊敬；受到高度評價
example: The senior legal counsel is highly regarded within the industry for his exceptional expertise in intellectual property law. (這位資深法務顧問因在智慧財產權法方面的卓越專業，在業界備受推崇。)

meaning: phr. 有能力；處於可以……的地位
example: Given our robust cash reserves, we are now in a prime position to aggressively acquire smaller competitors. (由於現金儲備充足，我們現在很有條件積極收購規模較小的競爭者。)

meaning: phr. 意見一致；達成共識
example: The board of directors and the executive team are completely in agreement regarding the proposed restructuring plan. (董事會和經營團隊對提議的組織重整計畫完全達成共識。)
The proposed salary adjustment seems to be in line with the current average compensation in the tech sector. (提議的薪資調整似乎符合目前科技業的平均薪酬水準。)

meaning: phr. 轉虧為盈；處於獲利狀態
example: Thanks to drastic cost-cutting measures, the department is finally in the black after two years of consistent losses. (多虧大幅削減成本，該部門在連續虧損兩年後終於轉虧為盈。)
After navigating a grueling twelve-hour negotiation, the team was hardly in the mood for celebrating. (經歷令人筋疲力盡的十二小時談判後，團隊根本沒有心情慶祝。)

meaning: phr. 處於虧損；入不敷出
example: The startup has been operating in the red for the past three quarters, prompting investors to demand immediate changes. (這家新創公司連續三季都在虧損，促使投資人要求立即改革。)

meaning: phr. 受外表影響；以貌取人
example: The hiring manager made a conscious effort not to be influenced by appearance during the interview process. (招募主管在面試過程中特別提醒自己不要以貌取人。)
The candidate's personal hobbies are entirely irrelevant to his capacity to perform this highly technical role. (求職者的個人嗜好與他是否有能力勝任這項高技術職務完全無關。)

meaning: phr. 被稱為；以……身分聞名
example: The visionary entrepreneur is widely known as a disruptive pioneer in the renewable energy sector. (這位富有遠見的企業家被廣泛視為再生能源領域的顛覆性先驅。)
The luxury automotive brand is globally known for its uncompromising commitment to passenger safety and engineering excellence. (這個豪華汽車品牌以堅持乘客安全及卓越工程品質而聞名全球。)

meaning: phr. 被置於無人看管的狀態；被留下不管
example: Security protocol strictly dictates that sensitive corporate documents must never be left unattended on desks. (安全規定嚴禁將敏感公司文件留在桌上無人看管。)

meaning: phr. 很可能會；有可能做……
example: Market analysts predict that the central bank is highly likely to raise interest rates again to combat inflation. (市場分析師預測，央行極可能再次升息以抑制通膨。)

meaning: phr. 兩旁排列著；沿線種有
example: The grand entryway to the luxurious resort is beautifully lined with towering, ancient palm trees. (豪華度假村氣派的入口兩旁，整齊排列著高聳的古老棕櫚樹。)
The newly developed, highly durable packaging is made of 100% biodegradable plant-based materials. (這款新開發且耐用的包裝由百分之百可生物分解的植物性材料製成。)
The agile project task force will be made up of top-performing specialists from various departments. (這個敏捷專案小組將由來自各部門、績效頂尖的專家組成。)
The high-definition security cameras must be securely mounted on the ceiling for an optimal viewing angle. (高畫質監視器必須牢固安裝在天花板上，才能取得最佳視角。)

meaning: phr. 以……著稱；因……受到注意
example: The seasoned consultant is particularly noted for his uncanny ability to streamline chaotic operational workflows. (這位資深顧問尤其以精簡混亂營運流程的非凡能力著稱。)

meaning: phr. 對……特別有吸引力；令……特別感興趣
example: The detailed consumer demographic data will be of particular interest to the strategic marketing division. (這份詳細的消費者人口資料，對策略行銷部門特別有參考價值。)

meaning: phr. 採取特殊飲食；有特殊飲食需求
example: Please inform the catering coordinator well in advance if any of the VIP guests are on a special diet. (若有貴賓需要特殊飲食安排，請務必事先通知餐飲協調員。)

meaning: phr. 正在旅行；正在出差
example: The Chief Operating Officer will be on a business trip inspecting the overseas manufacturing plants until next Friday. (營運長將出差視察海外製造廠，直到下週五才會回來。)

meaning: phr. 正在接聽另一通電話；正在另一場通話中
example: I tried to reach the regional director regarding the urgent contract, but her secretary informed me she was on another call. (我試著聯絡區域總監討論緊急合約，但她的秘書告訴我她正在接聽另一通電話。)

meaning: phr. 正在服藥；接受藥物治療
example: Employees who are on medication that may cause drowsiness should notify their supervisor before operating machinery. (正在服用可能引起嗜睡藥物的員工，操作機械前應通知主管。)

meaning: phr. 照常營業；開始營業
example: The downtown branch will be open for business from 9 a.m. on Monday. (市中心分店星期一上午九點開始營業。)
The interactive training module is specifically oriented to equip new hires with essential customer service skills. (這套互動式訓練教材專為讓新進員工具備必要的客戶服務技能而設計。)
The popular streaming platform is technically owned by a massive, multinational media conglomerate. (這個熱門串流平台實際上由一家大型跨國媒體集團持有。)

meaning: phr. 由……支付；由……負擔費用
example: All travel and accommodation expenses incurred during the tech summit will be fully paid for by the corporation. (科技高峰會期間產生的所有交通和住宿費用，都將由公司全額負擔。)

meaning: phr. 有資格擔任；適任於
example: Given her decade of experience in corporate litigation, she is exceptionally well-qualified for the role of General Counsel. (考量到她有十年的企業訴訟經驗，她非常適任法務長一職。)
The sudden drop in third-quarter revenue seems to be directly related to the massive recall of our flagship product. (第三季營收突然下滑，似乎與我們主力產品的大規模召回直接相關。)
Many established companies are notoriously reluctant to abandon their legacy systems and migrate completely to the cloud. (許多老牌公司都以不願放棄舊有系統、全面遷移至雲端而聞名。)
The major stakeholders appeared to be highly satisfied with the robust dividend yield proposed by the board. (主要利害關係人似乎對董事會提出的高股息殖利率相當滿意。)
The highly anticipated product launch event is tentatively scheduled for the second week of September. (備受期待的產品發表活動暫定於九月第二週舉行。)
Ladies and gentlemen, the keynote presentation is about to commence; please be seated promptly. (各位女士、先生，專題演講即將開始，請盡快就座。)
Management must be highly sensitive to the cultural nuances when negotiating contracts in foreign markets. (管理層在海外市場洽談合約時，必須充分留意文化上的細微差異。)

meaning: phr. 被遮蔭；處於陰影中
example: The outdoor seating area will be heavily shaded by the mature oak trees during the scorching summer months. (在酷熱的夏季，戶外座位區將有茂密的橡樹提供大片陰涼。)
The competitor's newly launched software interface appears to be remarkably similar to our proprietary design. (競爭對手新推出的軟體介面似乎與我們的專有設計非常相似。)
To mitigate systemic risk, our investment portfolio should be strategically spread out across various asset classes. (為了降低系統性風險，我們的投資組合應策略性地分散於各種資產類別。)
With his exceptional diplomatic skills and fluency in four languages, he is perfectly suited for the international liaison role. (憑藉出色的外交能力和流利的四種語言，他非常適合擔任國際聯絡人。)
The IT department was supposed to upgrade the firewall security protocols over the weekend, but the project was delayed. (IT 部門原本應在週末升級防火牆安全協定，但專案延誤了。)
The ultra-exclusive eco-resort is entirely surrounded by a pristine, legally protected tropical rainforest. (這座頂級生態度假村完全被一片原始且受法律保護的熱帶雨林環繞。)
Consumers are growing increasingly tired of intrusive, unskippable digital advertisements interrupting their content. (消費者越來越厭煩那些打斷內容、侵擾性又無法跳過的數位廣告。)
Vehicles parked illegally in the designated executive loading zone will be towed away at the owner's expense immediately. (違規停在指定主管卸貨區的車輛將立即被拖吊，費用由車主負擔。)
The union representatives were completely unwilling to compromise on the issue of mandatory overtime pay. (工會代表完全不願在強制加班費問題上做出妥協。)
The entire development team had to be up late fixing the critical bug before the software officially went live. (在軟體正式上線前，整個開發團隊都得熬夜修復重大錯誤。)
The veteran sales representative is quite used to handling aggressive objections from skeptical prospective clients. (這位資深業務代表很習慣應對抱持懷疑的潛在客戶提出的強烈異議。)

meaning: phr. 進度落後；落後於預定時程
example: Due to unforeseen supply chain disruptions, the construction of the new data center is now severely behind schedule. (由於供應鏈突發中斷，新資料中心的建設進度目前嚴重落後。)

meaning: phr. 信不信由你；令人意外的是
example: Believe it or not, the scrappy tech startup managed to secure series B funding during an economic downturn. (信不信由你，這家小型科技新創竟在經濟低迷期間成功取得 B 輪融資。)
The contested patent rights ultimately belong to the independent researcher, not the conglomerate that funded the study. (這項有爭議的專利權最終屬於獨立研究員，而不是出資進行研究的企業集團。)
The ergonomics expert demonstrated how to properly bend over to lift heavy boxes without straining the lower back. (人體工學專家示範如何正確彎腰搬起重箱，避免拉傷下背部。)
Whether the vendor was polite or not is entirely beside the point; they still failed to deliver the components on time. (廠商態度是否有禮完全不是重點；他們仍未能準時交付零件。)
We have secured a renowned best-selling author to deliver the keynote address at the upcoming literary festival. (我們已邀請一位知名暢銷書作家，為即將舉行的文學節發表專題演講。)

meaning: phr. 自行車架；腳踏車停放架
example: To promote eco-friendly commuting, the firm installed a secure, covered bicycle rack in the underground parking garage. (為推廣環保通勤，公司在地下停車場設置了安全且有遮棚的自行車架。)

meaning: phr. 帳單地址；帳款寄送地址
example: Please ensure that the billing address entered during checkout perfectly matches the address associated with your credit card. (請確認結帳時輸入的帳單地址與信用卡所登記的地址完全相符。)

meaning: phr. 帳單資訊；付款資料
example: For security purposes, our system automatically purges your sensitive billing information after the transaction is finalized. (基於安全考量，交易完成後系統會自動清除敏感的帳單資訊。)

meaning: phr. 把 A 歸咎於 B
example: The embattled management attempted to blame the devastating quarterly losses solely on unfavorable macroeconomic conditions. (陷入困境的管理層試圖把慘重的季度虧損全數歸咎於不利的總體經濟環境。)
The corporate wellness program offers free bi-monthly health screenings, including blood pressure and cholesterol checks. (企業健康計畫每兩個月提供免費健康檢查，包括血壓和膽固醇檢測。)

meaning: phr. 血液供應；血庫存量
example: The local hospital issued an urgent appeal for donations due to a critical shortage in the regional blood supply. (由於地區血液供應嚴重短缺，當地醫院緊急呼籲民眾捐血。)
Premium cabin passengers and those with frequent flyer status are invited to board the flight at their earliest convenience. (請豪華艙旅客及常客計畫會員儘早登機。)
The pivotal decision to acquire the struggling competitor will be put to a vote at tomorrow's emergency board meeting. (收購那家經營困難的競爭對手這項關鍵決策，將在明天的緊急董事會議上表決。)
The board of directors holds the ultimate fiduciary responsibility to act in the best interests of the company's shareholders. (董事會負有最終受託責任，必須以公司股東的最佳利益為依歸行事。)
Due to a last-minute aircraft swap, our departure has been reassigned to boarding gate 42 in Terminal B. (由於臨時更換飛機，我們的航班改到 B 航廈 42 號登機門出發。)
Passengers must present a valid passport and printed boarding pass to the security personnel before entering the sterile area. (旅客進入管制區前，必須向安檢人員出示有效護照和紙本登機證。)
Please refer to the information screens in the lounge for the most accurate and up-to-date boarding time. (請查看貴賓室內的資訊螢幕，以確認最準確、最新的登機時間。)
The marketing director tends to boast about the phenomenal conversion rates of his recent ad campaign, often inflating the numbers. (行銷主管常吹噓近期廣告活動驚人的轉換率，而且時常誇大數字。)
The chemical plant was heavily fined for illegally discharging toxic wastewater into a nearby body of water. (這家化工廠因非法將有毒廢水排入附近水域而遭重罰。)
The corporate retreat was hosted at a serene botanical garden to promote mindfulness and team cohesion among the executives. (主管共識營在一座幽靜的植物園舉行，藉此促進主管的正念與團隊凝聚力。)
Despite the numerous negative customer reviews, the vendor didn't even bother to respond or offer a remedy. (儘管有許多負面顧客評價，廠商甚至懶得回覆或提出補救方案。)
The massive cargo vessel, bound for the Port of Rotterdam, is carrying over three thousand containers of electronics. (這艘開往鹿特丹港的大型貨輪載有三千多個裝滿電子產品的貨櫃。)

meaning: phr. 分公司；分支辦事處
example: To better serve our expanding European client base, we are establishing a new branch office in Frankfurt next quarter. (為了更好地服務持續擴大的歐洲客戶群，我們將於下季在法蘭克福設立新分公司。)
The logistics division recently upgraded its entire delivery fleet with a batch of brand new, fuel-efficient hybrid vans. (物流部門最近用一批全新、省油的油電混合廂型車，更新了整個配送車隊。)

meaning: phr. 逐項拆解；分項說明
example: Can you please break down the exorbitant travel expenses in the budget proposal line by line? (請問你能否逐項拆解預算提案中高得驚人的差旅費？)

meaning: phr. 損益兩平點；收支平衡點
example: According to the aggressive financial forecast, the new product line should reach its break-even point within just eight months. (根據這份積極的財務預測，新產品線應能在短短八個月內達到損益兩平點。)
The stock market experienced a sudden dip following the breaking news of the unexpected geopolitical crisis. (意外地緣政治危機的突發新聞傳出後，股市突然下跌。)
The implementation of the agile framework is intended to bring about a significant increase in software development efficiency. (導入敏捷框架旨在大幅提升軟體開發效率。)
When attending the negotiation summit, please ensure you bring along all pertinent legal documentation. (出席談判高峰會時，請務必帶齊所有相關法律文件。)
The wildly successful holiday promotional campaign managed to bring in record-breaking revenue for the quarter. (大獲成功的假期促銷活動為本季帶來了破紀錄的營收。)
The severe economic downturn was largely brought on by the unprecedented disruption to the global supply chain. (這場嚴重的經濟衰退，很大程度上是全球供應鏈遭遇前所未有的中斷所造成的。)
The rigorous executive leadership program is meticulously designed to bring out the untapped potential in promising managers. (這項嚴謹的高階主管培訓計畫經過精心設計，旨在激發有潛力的經理人尚未發揮的能力。)
The international trade expo aims to bring together industry leaders and innovative startups from across the globe. (這場國際貿易展旨在匯聚全球各地的業界領袖與創新新創公司。)
During the strategic planning session, the CFO thoughtfully brought up the critical issue of dwindling cash reserves. (在策略規劃會議中，財務長審慎地提出現金儲備日益減少這個關鍵問題。)
The captain advised all passengers to buckle up as the aircraft was entering a zone of severe turbulence. (飛機即將進入強烈亂流區，機長因此提醒所有乘客繫好安全帶。)
The HR department posted the revised employee benefit scheme on the company's internal bulletin board. (人資部將修訂後的員工福利方案張貼在公司內部公告欄。)

meaning: phr. 偶然遇見；碰巧碰到
example: I coincidentally bumped into our former CFO at the international tech expo in Frankfurt. (我在法蘭克福的國際科技博覽會上偶然遇見了前任財務長。)
The shuttle service departs from the main bus stop adjacent to the corporate headquarters every fifteen minutes. (接駁車每十五分鐘從企業總部旁的主要公車站出發。)

meaning: phr. 商務服裝；商務正裝
example: All delegates attending the annual summit are strictly required to dress in formal business attire. (所有出席年度高峰會的代表都必須穿著正式商務服裝。)
We exchanged business cards after realizing our respective companies could mutually benefit from a strategic partnership. (發現雙方公司都能從策略合作中受益後，我們交換了名片。)
The executive board authorized the CEO to fly business class for all international transatlantic flights. (董事會核准執行長搭乘所有跨大西洋國際航班的商務艙。)

meaning: phr. 商業人脈；業務聯絡人
example: The seasoned sales director leveraged his extensive network of business contacts to secure the lucrative government contract. (資深業務主管運用廣泛的商業人脈，成功取得利潤豐厚的政府合約。)
Please allow three to five business days for the funds to be successfully transferred to your offshore account. (資金成功匯入您的海外帳戶，請預留三至五個工作日。)

meaning: phr. 商業交易；商業協議
example: The protracted negotiations ultimately culminated in a multi-million dollar business deal between the two tech giants. (漫長談判最終促成兩家科技巨頭之間數百萬美元的商業交易。)

meaning: phr. 營業時間；辦公時間
example: For urgent technical support outside of standard business hours, please contact our 24/7 dedicated hotline. (若在一般營業時間外需要緊急技術支援，請聯絡我們全天候服務的專線。)

meaning: phr. 企業管理；商業管理
example: She is pursuing a master's degree in business management to accelerate her trajectory toward an executive leadership role. (她正在攻讀企業管理碩士，希望加快自己邁向高階主管職位的步伐。)

meaning: phr. 商業慣例；商業行為
example: The ethics committee concluded that the aggressive marketing strategy constituted a highly deceptive business practice. (倫理委員會認定，這項激進的行銷策略構成極具欺騙性的商業行為。)

meaning: phr. 商務洽談；商業會談
example: The two executives had a business talk about the merger before signing the contract. (兩位主管在簽約前就合併案進行商務洽談。)
The regional manager is currently on an extensive business trip across Southeast Asia to audit our manufacturing facilities. (區域經理目前正在東南亞各地出差，稽核我們的製造設施。)

meaning: phr. 繁忙的街道；熱鬧的街區
example: The proposed flagship store is strategically located on a highly visible, busy street in the central financial district. (計畫中的旗艦店策略性地設在中央金融區一條醒目且繁忙的街道上。)
The artisanal restaurant sources its premium organic beef exclusively from a locally renowned butcher's shop. (這家講究手藝的餐廳只向當地知名肉舖採購頂級有機牛肉。)

meaning: phr. 敲定；完成最後細節
example: We need to button up the final draft of the acquisition proposal before presenting it to the board of directors. (向董事會簡報前，我們需要敲定收購提案最終草案的細節。)

meaning: phr. 以相當大的差距；大幅
example: The incumbent CEO was re-elected by a considerable margin, reflecting overwhelming shareholder confidence. (現任執行長以相當大的差距連任，反映股東對他抱持壓倒性的信心。)
To meet the uncompromising deadline, the critical replacement parts had to be shipped by air overnight. (為了趕上不能延誤的期限，關鍵替換零件必須連夜空運。)
If you require any further clarification on the revised tax regulations, by all means, do not hesitate to contact me. (如果您對修訂後的稅務規定還需要進一步說明，請務必隨時聯絡我。)
Due to the substantial transaction amount, the supplier requested that we settle the outstanding invoice by check. (由於交易金額龐大，供應商要求我們以支票結清未付款的發票。)

meaning: phr. 相較之下；相比之下
example: Last quarter's earnings were dismal; by contrast, this quarter we experienced an unprecedented surge in net profitability. (上一季的獲利十分慘淡；相較之下，本季淨利潤出現前所未有的激增。)
All online seminar registration fees must be paid in full by credit card prior to the commencement of the event. (所有線上研討會報名費都必須在活動開始前以信用卡全額支付。)
The highly confidential legal documents were delivered by hand to ensure maximum security and privacy. (這些高度機密的法律文件由專人親自送達，以確保最高程度的安全與隱私。)
The junior accountant authorized the hefty wire transfer to the wrong vendor account completely by mistake. (初階會計師完全是誤操作，才核准將巨額電匯款項匯入錯誤的廠商帳戶。)
The preliminary market research is insightful, but it is by no means a guarantee of the product's ultimate success. (初步市場調查很有參考價值，但絕不保證產品最終會成功。)
The CEO drafted the controversial press release entirely by herself to ensure absolute control over the corporate narrative. (執行長完全獨自起草這份引發爭議的新聞稿，以確保公司對外敘事完全由她掌控。)
We managed to iron out the final discrepancies in the contract by telephone just hours before the signing ceremony. (在簽約儀式前幾小時，我們透過電話順利解決了合約中最後的差異。)

word: by the end of the year
meaning: phr. 在年底前；到年底時
example: The firm anticipates finalizing the aggressive corporate restructuring phase by the end of the year. (公司預計在年底前完成大規模企業重組階段。)
By the time the auditors uncover the accounting irregularities, the rogue trader will have already fled the jurisdiction. (等稽核人員揭露會計違規時，那名不法交易員早已逃離該司法管轄區。)

meaning: phr. 到這個時候；此時已經
example: By this time next week, we will have successfully deployed the beta version of our new enterprise software. (到了下週的這個時候，我們應已成功部署新企業軟體的測試版。)
We routed the transatlantic shipment by way of the Panama Canal to significantly reduce the overall transit time. (為大幅縮短總運輸時間，我們將這批跨大西洋貨物改經巴拿馬運河運送。)

meaning: phr. 回電；稍後再打電話
example: I am currently occupied in an urgent board meeting; I will call you back as soon as we adjourn. (我目前正在參加緊急董事會議；會議一結束就會立刻回電給你。)
The escalating consumer inflation rates call for immediate and decisive intervention by the central bank. (消費者通膨率持續攀升，因此需要中央銀行立即果斷介入。)

meaning: phr. 尋求一些協助；請人幫忙
example: The intricate server migration process hit a snag, forcing the IT team to call for some assistance from an external consultant. (複雜的伺服器遷移作業遇上阻礙，迫使 IT 團隊向外部顧問尋求協助。)
Several key developers had to call in sick today, severely jeopardizing our strict project delivery timeline. (今天有幾位關鍵開發人員打電話請病假，嚴重危及嚴格的專案交付時程。)
Management decided to call off the highly anticipated merger after discovering massive hidden liabilities during due diligence. (管理層在盡職調查中發現巨額隱藏負債後，決定取消備受期待的合併案。)
The charismatic political leader called on his supporters to actively participate in the upcoming grassroots campaign. (這位魅力十足的政治領袖號召支持者積極參與即將展開的草根運動。)
The CEO had to call an urgent meeting to address the sudden, devastating plunge in the company's stock price. (公司股價突然大幅暴跌，執行長不得不召開緊急會議因應。)

meaning: phr. 公開指出；點名批評
example: The senior auditor did not hesitate to publicly call out the glaring discrepancies in the quarterly financial statements. (資深稽核員毫不猶豫地公開指出季度財務報表中明顯的差異。)
The agile startup was quick to capitalize on the sudden shift in consumer behavior driven by the global pandemic. (這家靈活的新創公司迅速善用全球疫情帶來的消費者行為轉變。)

meaning: phr. 汽車保養；車輛維護
example: The corporate fleet manager implemented a strict car maintenance schedule to ensure maximum vehicle reliability and safety. (公司車隊主管制定嚴格的汽車保養時程，以確保車輛的可靠性與安全性達到最高水準。)
All car rental expenses incurred during the business trip must be meticulously documented and submitted for reimbursement. (出差期間產生的所有租車費用，都必須詳實記錄並提交核銷。)
The newly appointed HR director genuinely seems to care for the well-being and professional growth of her subordinates. (新任人資主管似乎真心關心下屬的身心福祉與職涯成長。)
The courier was visibly struggling to carry a large, unwieldy parcel up the steep flight of stairs to the executive suite. (快遞員顯然很費力地抱著一個又大又難搬的包裹，沿陡峭樓梯送往主管辦公室。)
The firm commissioned an independent agency to carry out comprehensive market studies before launching the new product line. (公司委託獨立機構在推出新產品線前進行全面的市場研究。)

meaning: phr. 隨身行李；手提行李
example: Please ensure your carry-on baggage complies strictly with the airline's dimensions and weight restrictions to avoid excess fees. (請確認您的隨身行李嚴格符合航空公司的尺寸與重量限制，以免支付額外費用。)
The retail chain is upgrading every outdated cash register with state-of-the-art point-of-sale terminal systems. (這家零售連鎖店正將每一台老舊收銀機升級為最先進的銷售點終端系統。)

meaning: phr. 現金儲備；現金準備金
example: Thanks to a highly profitable fiscal year, the company boasts sufficient cash reserves to weather the impending economic downturn. (由於上一會計年度獲利豐厚，公司擁有充足的現金儲備，可安然度過即將到來的經濟衰退。)
Every eligible shareholder is strongly encouraged to cast a ballot at the upcoming extraordinary general meeting. (我們強烈鼓勵每位符合資格的股東在即將舉行的臨時股東大會上投票。)

meaning: phr. 蒙上陰影；投下陰影
example: The sudden departure of the visionary founder has undoubtedly cast a shadow over the tech company's future prospects. (這位富有遠見的創辦人突然離職，無疑為這家科技公司的未來前景蒙上陰影。)

meaning: phr. 外燴服務；餐飲承辦服務
example: For the annual gala, we have secured a five-star catering service to accommodate the complex dietary requirements of our VIPs. (為年度盛典，我們已安排五星級外燴服務，以滿足貴賓複雜的飲食需求。)
All critical policy decisions and high-level strategic directives must be unequivocally approved by the central office in London. (所有重要政策決策與高層策略指示，都必須獲得倫敦總部明確批准。)

meaning: phr. 執行長；執行長職位

meaning: phr. 削減福利；減少福利待遇

meaning: phr. 食品供應商；食材供應商

Ergonomic chairs with an adjustable footrest can significantly improve staff comfort during long work hours. (配有可調式腳踏墊的人體工學椅，可大幅提升員工長時間工作時的舒適度。)
The network connection will be unavailable for a short time this evening for routine maintenance. (今晚因例行維護，網路連線將暫停一小段時間。)

meaning: phr. 很久；好長一段時間

meaning: phr. 換個方式；為了改變一下

meaning: phr. 針對大額採購；購買大量商品時

meaning: phr. 為了……的利益；有利於

All invoices for international services must be paid in the designated foreign currency. (所有國際服務的發票都必須以指定外幣支付。)

meaning: phr. 對外貿易；國際貿易

meaning: phr. 轉寄地址；轉送地址

The museum offers free admission to all visitors on the first Sunday of every month. (博物館每月第一個星期日對所有訪客免費開放。)
The software technical support is available to all registered users free of charge. (所有已註冊使用者都可免費獲得軟體技術支援。)

meaning: phr. 免費停車；免費停車場

meaning: phr. 附加福利；員工福利

meaning: phr. 從今天起；自此以後

meaning: phr. 頭版新聞；頭版報導

meaning: phr. 冷凍食品；冷凍食品產品

meaning: phr. 燃料消耗量；耗油量

meaning: phr. 燃料排放；燃料廢氣

meaning: phr. 一般大眾；普通民眾

meaning: phr. 基因研究；遺傳研究

meaning: phr. 取得許可；申領許可證

meaning: phr. 領取處方藥；請藥局調劑處方

meaning: phr. 獲得升遷；得到晉升

meaning: phr. 取得替代品；換領新品

meaning: phr. 搭便車；搭乘他人的車

It is essential for all team members to get along with each other to maintain a productive work environment. (團隊成員彼此相處融洽，對維持高效率的工作環境至關重要。)
I managed to get an appointment with the department head for tomorrow morning to discuss the budget. (我成功約到部門主管明早會面，討論預算。)

meaning: phr. 重新聯絡；再次取得聯繫

I will look into the data and get back to you with an answer by the end of the day. (我會查閱資料，並在今天結束前回覆您。)
Please get in line behind the other attendees to ensure an orderly registration process for the event. (請排在其他與會者後方，以確保活動報到流程井然有序。)
If you have any further questions, please feel free to get in touch with our customer service representative. (如果您還有其他疑問，請隨時聯絡我們的客服代表。)
The new intern got lost in the large office complex while trying to find the training room. (新進實習生尋找訓練室時，在大型辦公園區裡迷路了。)

meaning: phr. 下班；離開工作崗位

meaning: phr. 取得某人的核准；獲得同意

The team worked hard to get over the initial difficulties and successfully launched the product on time. (團隊努力克服初期困難，最終如期成功推出產品。)
Employees are reminded that they will get paid on the last Friday of every month. (提醒員工，薪水將於每月最後一個星期五發放。)
Please keep all receipts from your business trip so that you can get reimbursed for your travel expenses. (請保留所有出差收據，以便申請差旅費報銷。)

meaning: phr. 做些運動；活動一下

meaning: phr. 把食物準備好；備餐

meaning: phr. 理解要點；明白意思

There is a lot of paperwork to get through before we can finalize the merger agreement. (在敲定合併協議前，我們還有大量文書工作要完成。)
It usually takes me about 45 minutes to get to the office during the morning rush hour. (早晨尖峰時段，我通常需要約四十五分鐘才能到辦公室。)
The department plans to get together after work on Friday to celebrate the successful team milestone. (部門計畫在週五下班後聚在一起，慶祝團隊成功達成里程碑。)
It takes a little time to get used to the new software interface, but it is much more efficient overall. (適應新的軟體介面需要一點時間，但整體而言它效率高得多。)
The winner of the performance challenge will receive a gift certificate for a local restaurant. (績效挑戰賽的優勝者將獲得一張當地餐廳的禮券。)

meaning: phr. 載 A 一程；讓 A 搭便車

meaning: phr. 預付 A 款項；給 A 預支款

meaning: phr. 給出優惠價格；提供好價錢

I would be happy to give a hand with the setup for the upcoming client presentation if you need help. (如果您需要幫忙，我很樂意協助準備即將舉行的客戶簡報。)

meaning: phr. 發表簡報；進行演示

The management is considering giving a raise to the core staff members to recognize their outstanding performance. (管理層正考慮為核心員工加薪，肯定他們的傑出表現。)

meaning: phr. 指路；提供方向指引

The volunteers will give out promotional materials to the attendees as they enter the conference hall. (志工會在與會者進入會議廳時，向他們發放宣傳資料。)
The old office layout will give way to a more modern, open design starting next month. (從下個月起，舊辦公室格局將被更現代、開放的設計取代。)

meaning: phr. 瞥一眼；迅速看一下
example: He took a quick glance at the clock to ensure he wouldn't be late for the meeting. (他迅速瞥了一眼時鐘，確認自己不會遲到開會。)

meaning: phr. 玻璃櫃；玻璃展示櫃

Please be careful when you go down the steps, as the area may be slippery due to the recent rain. (最近下過雨，地面可能濕滑，請小心走下台階。)
Please go downstairs to the lobby to pick up your registered guest for the tour. (請下樓到大廳接待已預約參觀的訪客。)

meaning: phr. 繼續推進；向前進行

Many students are inspired to go into business after hearing the guest speaker’s success story. (許多學生聽完特邀講者的成功故事後，受到啟發而想要創業。)
The meeting will go on as scheduled despite the inclement weather. (儘管天氣惡劣，會議仍會按預定時間舉行。)
Most of our management team plans to go on vacation during the quiet summer period. (管理團隊大多數成員計畫在夏季較清閒時去度假。)
Due to the severe market downturn, many small local shops were forced to go out of business. (由於市場嚴重低迷，許多當地小商店被迫倒閉。)
The older version of the software will go out of production next month, to be replaced by the updated release. (舊版軟體將於下個月停產，之後由更新版本取代。)
I usually go shopping for office supplies on Monday mornings before the office gets busy. (我通常在週一上午辦公室忙起來前，去採購辦公用品。)
After the flight arrives, please go straight to the hotel to check in before the afternoon meeting. (航班抵達後，請直接前往飯店辦理入住，以便趕上下午的會議。)

meaning: phr. 完成；經歷；仔細檢查

meaning: phr. 通過海關；辦理海關查驗

The team decided to go to a film together after the project deadline was successfully met. (專案順利趕上期限後，團隊決定一起去看電影。)
I think we should go with the blue design for the new brochure, as it looks more professional. (我認為新宣傳冊應採用藍色設計，因為看起來更專業。)

meaning: phr. 在……方面出錯；……發生故障

We are hosting a going away party for our long-time colleague who is retiring next month. (我們正為下個月退休的長年同事舉辦歡送會。)
Regular physical activity is good for your health and can improve overall workplace energy levels. (規律運動有益健康，也能提升整個職場的活力。)

meaning: phr. 政府補助金；政府補助款
example: The research project was successfully funded by a government grant aimed at promoting technological innovation. (這項研究專案成功取得政府補助金，該補助旨在促進技術創新。)

meaning: phr. 簡單吃點東西；吃一口

meaning: phr. 雜貨店；食品雜貨店

meaning: phr. 團體優惠價；團體費率
example: We are pleased to offer a discounted group rate for large delegations attending our annual conference. (我們很高興能為出席年度會議的大型代表團提供團體優惠價。)

meaning: phr. 成長潛力；發展潛力
example: The market study indicates that our product line has significant growth potential in the international market. (市場研究指出，我們的產品系列在國際市場具有相當大的成長潛力。)

meaning: phr. 訪客證；臨時通行證
example: All visitors are required to display their guest pass prominently while inside the secure office area. (所有訪客在辦公室管制區內都必須將訪客證佩戴在明顯處。)

meaning: phr. 客座講者；特邀演講者

meaning: phr. 導覽行程；導覽參觀

The bookstore is having a sale where all items from the previous season are marked at half price. (這家書店正在促銷，上季所有商品一律半價。)
All project proposals must be handed in to the department head by the end of the week. (所有專案提案都必須在本週結束前繳交給部門主管。)

meaning: phr. 度過漫長的一天；忙碌一整天

meaning: phr. 做……有困難；在……方面遇到問題

word: have A strapped to one's shoulder

Please have your identification card around at all times while you are working in the laboratory. (在實驗室工作時，請隨時把識別證帶在身上。)

meaning: phr. 幾乎沒有機會……；做……的可能性很低

meaning: phr. 剪頭髮；請人剪頭髮
example: I need to have my hair cut before the professional portrait session next week. (我需要在下週的專業肖像拍攝前去剪頭髮。)

meaning: phr. 忙得不可開交；忙不過來
example: The marketing team has their hands full preparing for the launch of three new products simultaneously. (行銷團隊忙著同時籌備三款新產品上市，已經忙得不可開交。)
Only authorized personnel have permission to do maintenance work on the internal server room. (只有獲授權的人員才能在內部伺服器機房進行維護工作。)

meaning: phr. 有理由做；有根據做
example: We have reason to do a follow-up investigation because the initial findings were inconclusive. (由於初步調查結果尚無定論，我們有理由進行後續調查。)

meaning: phr. 與……有關；和……有些關係
example: The recent increase in sales has something to do with our updated promotional strategy. (近期銷售額上升與我們更新後的促銷策略有關。)

meaning: phr. 提供最優惠的費率；價格最划算

meaning: phr. 心臟病發作；心肌梗塞

meaning: phr. 暖氣系統；供暖設備

meaning: phr. 交通壅塞；車流量大
example: Due to heavy traffic on the highway, the delivery service experienced several delays this morning. (由於高速公路交通壅塞，配送服務今早多次延誤。)

meaning: phr. 自行取用食物；自助取餐

meaning: phr. 招聘委員會；聘用小組

meaning: phr. 別掛電話；維持現狀

meaning: phr. 居家改善；住宅修繕

meaning: phr. 住宅開發；住宅建設案

meaning: phr. 人力資源；人資部門

meaning: phr. 我完全不知道；我毫無頭緒

meaning: phr. 如果我沒記錯的話

meaning: phr. 如果您方便；若您同意

meaning: phr. 如果你堅持；既然你堅持

meaning: phr. 進口許可證；輸入許可
